_doc: Copy to config/local.json (gitignored). Secrets are REFERENCES resolved by ops/fleet_kit/fleet_secrets.py - never a literal value here.

overlay._doc: Plan 022. anchor: tl|tr|bl|br|ml|mr or {"x": int, "y": int} (work-area relative); default ml keeps it off the top-right minimap. display: index into the display list, null = primary. scale 0.8-1.6. opacity (panel) 0.5-0.95.

notify._doc: Plan 026. Per-rule OS notifications (dashboard toasts follow the same switches). Defaults: marketAlert and buffEnding on, the rest off. bossSoon (plan 032): 15 and 5 min before each world boss spawn not yet looted. silent: no notification sound (default true).

ocr._doc: engine: auto (Tesseract if found, else Windows OCR) | tesseract | windows. tesseract: optional path to tesseract.exe when not on PATH or in the default install dir.

loop._doc: tools/ew_loop.py tick. inbox_dir / outbox_dir default to <root>/moon_sync_inbox and moon_sync_outbox. max_notes_per_day: kit v8 item 14 cap 6 (may lower, never raise; only ORDER/FIX/RULING-class notes are exempt, order-closing ANSWERs count).

market._doc: Plan 027. Net proceeds after the 35 percent market tax. vp: true while a Value Pack is active (+30 percent of the after-tax amount). fame_pct: the Family Fame sale bonus shown in game, 0-1.5 (percent). Restart the server after editing.

profile._doc: Plan 061. base_url: a self-hosted BDO-REST-API instance (man90/bdo-rest-api, loopback default shown). Blank = profile source off. The public instance is robots-disallowed and is never called; a non-loopback base is used only while its robots.txt allows Ebonwake.
